title: Skybreaker
summary: A +1 light hammer that grants Searing Smite.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d4 + 1 Bludgeoning plus Strength. +1 to attack. Simple, light, thrown, 5 ft melee.
fields.Searing Smite: Level 1. Once per Long Rest. Melee weapon attack using an Action. On hit spend the Bonus Action to add 1d6 Fire and apply a burn with Concentration. Constitution save cadence can end the burn, which otherwise deals 1d6 Fire per turn.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Deal weapon damage on hit. Constitution save vs higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2 avoids Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed removes Dexterity AC bonus and reactions and gives disadvantage on Wisdom saves. Help ends it.
fields.Acquisition: Locked heavy chest near the entrance.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
